response.sql: WITH snapshots AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt, AVG(s.shortintrt) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS mix_avg_shortintrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref) SELECT transref, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(shortintrt) / NULLIF(MAX(mix_avg_shortintrt), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM snapshots GROUP BY transref, ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A zero or missing order type baseline produces a NULL ratio.
